question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Though'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's take a look at the phrase: _________poor,he was proud his learning.
 
• ** Let's take a look at the options:**
 
 
• **​Though: **It is used as a conjunction and an adverb to modify the information in a sentence or sentences.
 
 
• ** Example:** **Though** he is rich,he is unkind.
 
 
 
• **So: **So is used as a subordinating conjunction to introduce clauses of result or decision.
 
 
• **Example: ** It was a long journey, **so** I'm really tired now.
 
 
 
• **Because: **Because' is a subordinating conjunction and it connects a subordinate clause to the main one. It is used when we want to give the reason behind something.** **
 
 
• **Example: ** I couldn't hold on anymore** because **the relationship was too toxic for me.** **
 
 
 
• **Even: **Even is an adverb. We use even to refer to something surprising, unexpected, unusual or extreme.
 
 
• **Example: ** He didn't **even** have enough money to pay the rent.
 
 
 
 
 
• The options have been discussed in details and findings is that the phrase needs a word that modify the the the clause: **'he was proud his learning'.**
 
• So, the option** though **is appropriate for the given blank.

Therefore, the correct answer is option no.**(1) **The complete phrase is:** *Though__ poor, he was proud his learning.***
